verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community user who says they have run Ollama on an AMD GPU for weeks and that Ollama has 'shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27'. That points to official container images existing, but the pack has no first-party documentation of containerized deployment. Missing for 10: first-party Docker/container image documentation, run/configuration instructions (ports, volumes, GPU passthrough), CPU/NVIDIA container variants, guidance on reproducible deployment such as pinned tags or persisting models, and broader independent corroboration.
